label: Кричать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for кричать (to shout, yell).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 'Кричу' is the -у form of кричать, taken after the hushing ч. 'От радости' uses от with the genitive to give the cause of shouting.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Кричишь' shows the -ишь ending of кричать. The imperfective fits an ongoing or repeated noise.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Кричит' is the core -ит form of кричать. 'На всю улицу' is a fixed phrase meaning across the whole street.
Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Кричим' takes the -им ending. 'Чтобы нас услышали' is a purpose clause showing why the shouting continues.
Strategic focus: Polite or plural present. 'Кричите' is the respectful -ите form of кричать. 'Без всякой причины' uses без with the genitive for a pointed reproach.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Кричат' closes the ladder with the -ат ending, taken after ч instead of -ят. 'В утреннем небе' sets the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Past, masculine. 'Кричал' is the masculine -л past of кричать. 'Во сне' uses в with the prepositional case to mean during sleep.
Strategic focus: Past, feminine. 'Кричала' adds the feminine -ла ending. 'От страха' uses от with the genitive to name the cause of the cry.

missions.phrase: Не надо так кричать на детей.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imperfective infinitive. 'Кричать' stays infinitive after 'не надо'. The imperfective marks repeated or sustained yelling; буду кричать would build its compound future.
Strategic focus: Imperative, singular. 'Кричи' is the informal command of кричать, here negated with 'не' to tell someone to stop yelling. The imperfective is normal for a negated command of process.
